purpose: Original cave panoramas and independent landmarks, October 2026
landmarkPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent environment sprite atlas for an original top-down pixel-art fantasy action RPG, high three-quarter overhead camera with visible vertical faces, matching dense 32px-tile character scale. FOUR SEPARATE major subterranean ruin landmarks in a precise 2x2 grid on a 1536x1536 canvas. Each sprite entirely within its 768px square cell, large empty alpha gap between cells. No background, no rectangular floor tile, no text, no labels, no UI, no characters. Genuine transparent background. Beautiful authored hard-edged pixel clusters, restrained 6 shade steps per material, large readable silhouettes, small weathering details and moss, no blur. Intimidating yet elegant mysterious underground archaeology. Each sprite approximately600x610px maximum with fully visible margins. View all four from same south-facing camera elevation. Their bases are narrow footing rubble, not large floor patches.
TOP LEFT: collapsed ancient subterranean excavation machinery: monumental weathered stone retaining piers and three aged timber crossbeams, a large broken bronze hoist wheel wedged into a solid cracked masonry panel, rusty chain, two tiny subdued warm amber lanterns, abandoned mineral carts partly buried at base, a hint of olive root growth. Solid rear panel, NO open doorway suggesting traversable entrance. Warm ochre limestone and desaturated old wood, layered worn textures, massive clear structural volume.
TOP RIGHT: a colossal twisting dead world-tree root wrapped around a broken ancient inscribed stone stele and fluted pillar. Roots split into 3 broad interlocking buttresses, moss and olive fern colonies in joints, few subdued amber resin droplets. Central slate monolith partly exposed with eroded abstract geometric carvings, no readable text. Asymmetric root silhouette, one tall bare branch reaching upward. Original sacred forgotten-grove impression; NO skulls/faces.
BOTTOM LEFT: a fragment of an ancient flooded aqueduct shrine: staggered carved stone piers and a broken arch supporting a shallow elevated stone channel, sealed dark backing masonry. Gnarled roots, lush clustered large-to-small turquoise luminescent mushrooms around bases, modest tiny pale cyan gem deposits. Mossy grey limestone, wet teal lower stones. Small thin water streak down stone into an inset basin; NO large animated water curtain, no detached ground puddle. Distinct graceful ruined architecture, not a mushroom repeated alone.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a buried astronomical relic standing vertically: a massive broken double stone-and-aged-bronze ring set into two thick fluted monolithic supports, solid central broken obelisk of dark blue-grey stone, fractured engraved bands and a tiny muted blue-white light trapped in its centre. Ring is partial, asymmetrically collapsed, one fragment leaning at base. Deep indigo stone, tarnished bronze, silver cold edge highlights, low vines. Sacred silent ancient mechanism; NO neon magic circle, NO active portal, NO bright aura, NO faces. Awe from architectural mass and restrained light. Small crystalline mineral veins in stone. All four landmarks highly distinctive, visually harmonious, clear readable foreground edges with naturally darker rear planes. Entire sprite cutouts including bases, no cropping, no rectangular shadow backdrop.
landmarkLayoutRepair: Edit only arrangement and clean transparency of this 2x2 production game sprite atlas, preserving the four detailed original subterranean ruin designs and matching pixel art style. Reposition and proportionally shrink EACH sprite entirely into its own quadrant, with at least70pixels clear alpha margin along EVERY edge of its quadrant. Top left excavation hoist monument, top right root stele, bottom left mushroom aqueduct ruin, bottom right astronomical broken ring monument. Entire sprite including base stays within cell. Give LARGE completely transparent corridors at horizontal and vertical centre. Remove edge halos; hard-edged transparent silhouette. No white or black background. No extra objects or letters. 1536x1536square if possible. Layout and transparency cleanup only.

backdrops.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production FULL-MAP DISTANT BACKDROP for an original overhead 2D pixel-art fantasy RPG. One cohesive breathtaking subterranean panorama, not an asset sheet, not a dungeon floor plan. Approximately 7:6 landscape composition, 1792x1536 if possible. High three-quarter overhead view looking north/down into an immense enclosed underground expanse. Clearly authored pixel clusters, sharp edges, stepped limited material shading, no smooth blur or photoreal rendering. Large architectural silhouettes separated by dark atmospheric depth; strong artistic composition suitable as a beautiful game wallpaper. Lighting subdued, background less bright than playable characters. Palette darkest near foreground edges, midtones on distant structures, just a few tiny warm/cool light accents. No text, symbols resembling labels, UI, characters, logos, watermark. The game overlays its own walkable platforms and collision boundaries over the central 65 percent: keep the very centre quiet low-contrast shadowed distance rather than a strong focal statue. Architecture and storytelling details concentrate in top quarter, left and right outer thirds, and bottom corners. Give ample coherent cavern depth everywhere; never fill entire surface with random rocky texture. No outside sky or sun. Foreground dark silhouettes at lower corners frame the scene, distant middle planes imply scale. Do not draw bright paths or doorways implying accessible entrances. No borders. Theme: A vast forgotten excavation cavern containing several enormous abandoned stone galleries, monumental bronze winch wheels, splintered timber gantries and chain lifts suspended at multiple depths above an unseen dark chasm. Distant retaining arches carved into weathered ochre limestone, layered stone aqueduct piers half buried in roots. Warm desaturated ochre, dark umber, hints of olive and smoke teal. Two tiny amber lantern clusters establish scale. Architectural mass, broken platforms receding diagonally, fascinating quiet archaeology. The rim at top left holds largest ruined mining facade; smaller ruins recede along right side. No continuous wall of identical boulders.
